ShortDescription: Password reset not working for SAP
Description: User reports password reset link for SAP system returns an error. Self-service portal shows 'account locked' but AD shows active.

ShortDescription: Delegation setup fails for manager approval
Description: Manager cannot configure delegation for approval workflows. System shows 'insufficient privileges' when attempting to set up a delegate.
New employee in Finance department did not receive standard entitlements during onboarding. Joiner provisioning workflow completed but access bundle was empty.

ShortDescription: Departed user still has active access
Description: Terminated employee still showing active entitlements 30 days after departure. Leaver workflow did not trigger deprovisioning for cloud applications.

ShortDescription: SoD violation not flagged during certification
Description: Separation of Duties conflict between AP Clerk and AP Manager roles was not detected during last certification campaign. User holds both conflicting entitlements.
Q4 access certification campaign shows 90% complete but has been stuck for 2 weeks. Remaining reviewers report they cannot see their review tasks.
Role mining analysis produces different results each run for the same department. Entitlement clustering does not converge to stable role definitions.
Entitlement request REQ-2025-0892 has been in pending state for 10 business days. Approval workflow appears stalled at second-level manager approval.

ShortDescription: Bulk provisioning failed for department transfer
Description: Bulk transfer of 15 users from Sales to Marketing department failed midway. 8 users have mixed old and new entitlements creating an inconsistent state.

ShortDescription: Orphan accounts detected in Azure AD
Description: Monthly reconciliation found 47 orphan accounts in Azure AD with no matching HR record. Accounts have active entitlements but no identifiable owner.

ShortDescription: Emergency access not revoked after use
Description: Break-glass access granted for production incident INC-9921 was not automatically revoked after the 24-hour window. User still has elevated privileges.
Audit finding: over 200 resource entitlements have blank or generic descriptions making certification reviews ineffective. Reviewers cannot make informed decisions.
